scalars.scalar_value: One (1) year of experience, or formal training related to military educational services

items.item_text: 01. All applicants are required to submit responses to the following supplemental questions. Your responses will provide information about your background and experience related to this position and will be used in the screening and selection process. Be concise yet specific and informative in your responses to these supplemental questions. "See resume," attachments or links will not be accepted as a substitute for your responses to the questions in the following boxes. Incomplete responses will not be considered. Please indicate below that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes | No

02. I understand that my application will be considered incomplete if any required sections of the application are not completed and/or if any documents that are required are not attached to my online application by the closing date. Options: Yes | No
03. I have completed all sections of the application including references. (Statements such as "see resume" will not be acceptable.) Options: Yes | No
04. Please specify your highest level of education. Options: High School or equivalent (GED) | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Juris Doctor | Doctorate Degree
05. Please indicate the field in which you have earned your degree in:

06. Indicate the full-time equivalent years of experience or formal training related to military educational services Options: Less than one year | One year | Two years | Three years | Four years | Five years or more

07. Indicate where you have worked to obtain experience in the area of formal training related to military educational services. What was the time frame, what was the employer's name and describe the work you performed. [This section is required.]
08. Indicate the level of knowledge in regarding VA educational benefit regulations. Options: None | Low | Moderate | High | Very high
09. Indicate the level of knowledge in developing grants or obtaining external funding. Options: None | Low | Moderate | High | Very high
10. Describe your experience managing a budget and explain your responsibilities. [This section is required.]

11. Describe how you have demonstrated sensitivity and understanding in delivery of services and support to a diverse workforce and student population (diverse in terms of socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic background). This section is required.
12. Describe a time when you ensured compliance with federal or state regulations. What was your role and what was the outcome?

13. Please indicate which of the following you have professional experience with. Options: VA Educational Benefits (GI Bill) | SCO (School Certifying Official) responsibilities | VA Enrollment Certifications | Federal compliance reporting | Student veteran orientation | Program assessment | Budget development | Budget monitoring | Grant writing | Grant administration | Staff supervision | Performance evaluations | Hiring and recruitment | Community partnerships | Veteran outreach events | Data analysis/reporting | Crisis intervention or student referrals | Housing or community referrals | Mental health resource coordination | FERPA compliance | None of the above

14. Which student populations have you primarily served? Options: Veterans | Active Duty Military | Reservists | National Guard | Military Dependents | First Generation Students | Foster Youth | International Students | Students with Disabilities | General Student Population

15. Which best describes your supervisory experience? Options: No supervisory experience | Led projects but no direct supervision | Supervised 1-5 employees | Supervised 6-10 employees | Supervised more than 10 employees

16. What best describes your experience preparing reports for federal or state agencies? Options: None | Limited exposure | Assisted with reporting | Independently prepared reports | Oversaw reporting for an entire department

17. Indicate where you have worked to obtain experience in administering VA educational benefits. Include: Employer Position Dates Your specific responsibilities Approximately how many veteran students you served annually This section is required.
A Master’s degree, or higher.
One (1) year of experience, or formal training related to military educational services
Two (2) years of experience, or formal training related to military educational services

Implements departmental policy changes, policy modifications, special assignments, goals, action plans, objectives to ensure that the center is operating in compliance with federal regulations and state statutes that govern the educational services provided to veterans of the U.S Military and their dependents.
Analyze employee performance to develop performance evaluations and address performance issues.
Participates in the District’s recruitment process to assist the supervising manager in hiring classified and unclassified staff.
Apportions work amongst subordinate staff.
Engages in employee discipline.
Approves paid time off for all employees under supervision.

Completes assessment of departmental services and programs to assist the supervising manager develop short/long term goals, and ensure that the department continues to provide services that meet the needs of veteran, military-affiliated students, and their dependents.
Completes federal, state, county, and District reports for the area under responsibility.
Monitors area budget to assist the supervising manager in tracking, developing, and administering the departmental budget.
Ensures compliance with grant guidelines to ensure that grant outcomes are met.
Develop a reporting system to provide statistical and financial data to District administration and outside agencies related to Veteran Services.

Ensures that eligible and potential students are informed about their benefits, new and existing laws, and veterans’ services available to them through proactive communication; monitors the intake and assessment of needed veterans’ services for appropriate referrals.

Organizes veteran-related events, services, and activities to provide support services to the District’s veteran student population in terms of, but not limited to, mental health, temporary housing options for veterans, meal vouchers, career workshops, and additional financial aid.
Locates funding sources to support Veteran Resource Center initiatives.
Organizes the VA Student Work-Study Allowance program to ensure that the District complies with federal and state rules, regulations, and guidelines that govern the program.
Ensures collaboration with other offices regarding the effective and efficient delivery of services to veterans and military-affiliated students.
Evaluates the enrollment status of students receiving VA Benefits to ensure that the District makes appropriate payment disbursements, adjustments, and reports information to the VA.

Ensures timely submittal of the District’s college catalog and requested information about the District’s degree and certificate programs to the VA to have an annual determination of which programs are eligible for VA benefits.
Organizes visits from the VA Education Compliance Survey Specialists to ensure that auditors access all required information and necessary campus areas.

Analyzes data related to veteran and active military student enrollment, credit assessment, graduation, retention, and alumni information to prepare administrative reports on the utilization and effectiveness of the support services offered through the Veterans Resource Center.
Performs related duties as assigned.
Federal and state regulations, requirements, and procedural guidelines about veteran or military-affiliated students and their dependents
Develops and administers programs and services at the College by understanding veteran and active military students' unique needs and removes barriers for the success of these students
Federal and state regulations, requirements, and procedural guidelines about mandated reporting requirements for veteran or military-affiliated students and their dependents
Maintain up-to-date on the current state and federal regulations impacting the educational benefits and reporting requirement of veteran or military-affiliated students
Federal, state, and local programs that provide services for veterans and military-affiliated individuals
Develop competent and productive staff through effective selection and supervision
Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)
Effectively develop methods to assess the effectiveness of departmental events, services, and activities
District Policies
Ensure that data/information is gathered in a timely and accurate manner, appropriate information is reported, and reporting deadlines are met
Collective bargaining agreements

Effectively develops and administers programs and services for the VRC by understanding the unique needs of veteran and active military students and seeking to remove barriers to success for these students
Student learning outcomes (SLOs) & Program Review
Develop and maintain collegiate relationships with District staff, students, and external agencies
Enterprise resource planning software

Ensure compliance with collective bargaining contracts and District policies when approving paid time off, hiring classified and unclassified staff, engaging in the progressive discipline process, and conducting performance evaluations
Use enterprise resource planning software to develop requisitions for the use of departmental funds, grant funds and to monitor the area budget.
Use timekeeping software to verify and approve the use of paid time off for subordinate employees

Apply knowledge of state and federal regulations that govern the educational benefits of veterans and their dependents to ensure compliance with regulations, the VA Student Work-Study Program, ensure timely submittal of reports and required information to the VA, retain required documentation as requested by the VA, and provide accurate information to students of the VRC
Facilitates a work environment that encourages knowledge and respect to develop skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds.
Apply knowledge of FERPA to ensure the security of student records
Communicate effectively, orally, and in writing

Apply knowledge of federal and state regulations, requirements, and guidelines for mandated reporting to retain appropriate documentation in student records, gather relevant information for VA reporting deadlines. Provides auditors with the requested information and notifies the VA of enrollment information, enrollment changes, student grades, and student conduct incidents

Use knowledge of federal, state, and local programs for veterans and military-affiliated individuals to garner services such as, but not limited to, social services, mental health services, housing assistance, and work rehabilitation programs
Apply knowledge of SLOs and Program Reviews to assess whether the department meets its short- and long-term objectives
Use general office software to develop grant applications, orientation materials, information materials, create reports, aggregate data, and communicate with staff, students, and external agencies
